recurrent_mechanisms.mechanism: Eligible A2A T1 trajectories fail before a material multi-role version-review chain forms.
Long/stalled execution is consistently attributable to runtime/role-service nondevelopment rather than CPR persistence.

divergence_patterns: G2 exposes an explicit A2A transport/runtime exception; G3 and G4 remain at non-material release-lead/service boundaries without a substantive downstream chain.
G5-X3-T1 is excluded from Layer-C because the natural run never produced an adequate process surface, so no semantic result is imputed for that group.
boundary_interpretation: This is a process-observability cohort: absence of supported C/P/R is conditional on failure to enter the mechanism-bearing part of the task.
A 64-decision horizon without multi-role execution is not treated as R.
cross_group_semantic_synthesis.cohort_conclusion: A2A X3-T1 is uniformly negative across the three eligible trajectories because the version-review process fails to develop into material cross-role execution. Together with the excluded G5 boundary cell, the cohort defines an observability limit rather than a claim that A2A cannot exhibit CPR under other task paths.

constraints: Cell-level Layer-C verdicts are sealed and are not modified by cohort synthesis.
Boundary-excluded natural cells remain excluded rather than imputed.
Dimension recurrence is descriptive across frozen stochastic realizations; it is not a rerun-based reproducibility claim.
